school.school_name: 岩手医科大学医療専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a dense Wix information page where the target confirmation-form section is stale but a later non-target section already has 令和8年度 links.
search_queries: 岩手医科大学医療専門学校 令和8年度 更新確認申請書
岩手医科大学医療専門学校 確認申請書 様式第2号
steps: Start from the Iwate official-index artifact row for 岩手医科大学医療専門学校.
Follow the official-index link to https://www.iwate-iryo-dh.com/blank-7.
Find the section headed 大学等における修学の支援に関する法律施行規則第7条第2項に基づく確認申請書.
Observe that this target confirmation-form section exposes links from 令和元年度 through 令和７年度 only.
Open the latest 令和７年度 target-form PDF and verify that its body contains 岩手医科大学医療専門学校 and 様式第２号.
Classify it as latest-public publication-lag evidence for FY2026 because the later 令和8年度 text on the page belongs to the シラバス section, not the target confirmation-form section.

reusable_rules: On dense Wix information pages, keep fiscal-year context local to the current disclosure subsection instead of using page-wide future-year text.
Treat a latest visible 令和７年度 confirmation-form PDF as publication-lag evidence for FY2026 when the target confirmation-form section has no 令和８年度 link.
Accept the PDF as a target-form candidate because the body contains the school name and 様式第２号, but do not count it as strict FY2026 success.
anti_patterns: Do not let a later 令和8年度 syllabus or course-list section upgrade a stale confirmation-form link to current-year success.
Do not classify the stale target-form PDF as non-target merely because it is old; keep it visible as latest-public operator evidence.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the official-index-linked Wix information page. Project HTML extraction found the latest confirmation-form section PDF as direct pattern_type with anchor 令和７年度; source-side PDF text extraction verified 岩手医科大学医療専門学校 and 様式第２号 in the PDF body. The page's 令和8年度 text belongs to the later シラバス section.
